question: In a Van de Graaff generator, why is the charge transferred to a large spherical dome instead of a small conductor? Give reason using the relation for potential of a sphere.

options.A: For a given charge, $V=\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\frac{Q}{R}$ is lower for a larger radius, reducing charge leakage and allowing the dome to accumulate more charge
options.B: A small conductor has zero potential, whereas a large dome has finite potential
options.C: A large dome has no electric field at its surface, irrespective of charge
options.D: The potential of a sphere is directly proportional to its radius for the same charge
